questions.prompt: How is your hair feeling at the moment?
questions.help: Damaged means it breaks or snaps easily, feels gummy or stretchy when wet, or colour will not hold. Dry means rough, straw-like or with lots of split ends.

options.label: Dry, rough or with split ends
Damaged: breaks, feels gummy or will not hold colour

questions.prompt: How does your hair dry if you leave it alone?
questions.help: Let it dry with no products. Go by most of your hair. Straight falls flat, wavy bends in loose S shapes, curly makes loops, coily makes tight zigzags or tiny coils.

questions.prompt: How thick are your individual strands?
questions.help: Roll one hair between your fingers: fine is hard to feel, coarse feels like thread.

questions.help: Roots and all over combined.

questions.prompt: Does your skin lean warm, cool or neutral?
questions.help: Rough clues: gold jewellery tends to suit warm skin and silver cool skin. Veins on the inner wrist look greener on warm skin and bluer on cool skin. Skin that tans easily often leans warm. Your own answer is what we use.
